note: The pad arc at every house-v2 position the producer does not arrange (PLAN-UNIFY §1.12, U3; his goal for the round: "the pads move across the main and still sit behind"). The theme's own pad is reshaped across each long main, never a second pad laid over it and never a new layer: each restrike keeps its time, its chord and its length, and takes its place on the main's arc, from a thin, close, dry opening to a crest and settling into the main's end. Along the arc (0 its thinnest, 1 its crest): how many of the chord's voices sound (the top ones leave at the thin end, the chord as written at the crest, never fewer than `voicing.least`), the level, the width (the voice's own spread) and the air (its reverb send). The arc reads the arrangement's phrases (`track.phrasing`): the crest is a phrase no sub-segment stands in, ending where the main's cooldown starts, and the arc holds still across a sub-segment (a breakdown-lite, a filtered phrase), so the two gestures never fight. Each knob is in the unit it declares (src/musical-time.ts) and leaned by the one lean (src/lean.ts), about the house's own birds. Every number is a starting point for listening.

units.says: what each knob counts: bars are the theme's written grid, phrases the phrase map's; dB absolute; width and air factors on the note's own spread and reverb send; an arc position 0 to 1; a lean is the one lean's

centre.says: the house's own birds (src/spell.ts HOUSE): every lean of this row is nought there

shape.says: where the arc stands at the main's first bar (`open`; `afterDrop` where a drop hands the main its energy), rising in a straight line to the crest, the crest held across its phrase, then settling to `settle` at the main's last bar; `crest`: `last` puts it on the last phrase before the cooldown (the line toward the main's end, the house), `middle` on the phrase nearest the main's middle (a breath)

voicing.says: at the thin end up to `drop` of the chord's voices leave, by function from its root: the extensions first (the ninth, the eleventh, the thirteenth), then the seventh, then a doubled root or fifth; never the third, never under `least` voices, and a chord with nothing that may leave is not thinned; they return as the arc rises; a chord a track row's own part owns keeps every voice

lean.says: Zephyr, brightness and air: the arc's width and air wider and airier up (x0.86 at nought, x1.28 at one about the house's 0.377)

slow.says: the slow side (under `leastBpm`), behind its own switch (`on`, off: the ambients are "actually the most interesting content", his word 10-13, and 27191 stays as it is; one optional pair waits for his ear): a slow breath, not a line — the crest in the main's middle, the chord's voices kept, the level, width and air moving less
